name: company-jobs-scraper
title: Career Page Scraper — Jobs from Any Company Careers Page
description: Paste company websites: finds each careers page, detects Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Personio, Teamtailor, Workable or Recruitee and returns every open job as JSON with seniority and salary. $2 per 1,000 jobs.

query.description: The input line (company website, careers page or job-board URL) this row answers

found.description: true: a job row; false: the one explanatory row of a company without jobs (never charged)

reason.description: Why a company has no job rows (null on job rows): invalid_url, site_unreachable, robots_disallowed, unsupported_platform, no_supported_ats_detected, ats_board_empty, ats_board_not_found, ats_board_disallowed, ats_board_failed, duplicate_input, not_processed

reason_detail.description: Plain-English explanation of `reason` (null on job rows)

careers_page_url.description: Page where the job board was found (the board URL itself when given directly); on rows without jobs the careers page we read, if any

detected_platform.description: Job platform found for the company: the ats on job rows; on rows without jobs also unsupported ones (smartrecruiters, icims, successfactors, taleo, phenom, eightfold ...)

job_id.description: Stable id: ats:board:posting_id (null on rows without jobs)

title.description: Job title exactly as posted by the company

company_name.description: Company name as shown on its job board; null when the board does not state it

company_board.description: The company's board id on its ATS (e.g. stripe on Greenhouse, nvidia.wd5/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite on Workday); use it in the companies input

ats.description: Applicant tracking system (job board platform) the job is hosted on

department.description: Department as stated by the company (e.g. Engineering); null when not given

team.description: Team or sub-department as stated by the company; null when not given

employment_type.description: Normalized employment type: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship, other; null when not stated

seniority.description: Level read from the job title by fixed rules (no AI): intern, entry, mid, senior, lead, manager, director, executive; null when the title has no level marker

workplace_type.description: remote, hybrid or onsite, from the ATS's own field or the location text; unknown when neither says

locations.description: Location strings as posted (city, region, country); empty when none given

country_codes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes resolved from the locations (e.g. US, DE); empty when no country could be resolved

remote.description: true when the job is remote, false when it is on-site or hybrid, null when unknown

salary_min.description: Lower end of the stated pay range, in salary_currency per salary_period; null when no pay is stated

salary_max.description: Upper end of the stated pay range (equals salary_min for a single figure); null when no pay is stated

salary_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the pay range (e.g. USD, EUR); null when no pay is stated

salary_period.description: Pay period of salary_min/salary_max: year, month, week, day or hour; null when no pay is stated

salary_source.description: structured: the ATS's own pay fields; description: pay stated in the description text (needs the description); null: no salary

years_experience_min.description: Minimum years of experience the description asks for ("3+ years", "3-5 years" -> 3); null when not stated or the description was not read

visa_sponsorship.description: true: the description says visa sponsorship is offered; false: it says sponsorship is not available; null: not mentioned, or the description was not read

posted_at.description: When the company published the job (ISO 8601, UTC), from the ATS; null when the ATS does not give it

updated_at.description: When the posting was last changed (ISO 8601, UTC), from the ATS; null when not given

apply_url.description: URL where a candidate applies (often the job page itself)

job_url.description: Public job page on the company's careers site / ATS

description_text.description: Full job description as plain text (HTML removed); null when not requested or not available (see description_status)

description_snippet.description: First 300 characters of the description as plain text; null when no description is available

description_status.description: included: full text fetched live from the ATS; not_requested: includeDescription=false; unavailable: live fetch failed or the ATS has no text

duplicate_sources.description: job_ids of copies of this job (same company, title and locations) found on other boards and merged into this row; empty when none

match_score.description: Keyword relevance 0-100: every keyword in the title 100, some in the title 60-70, department/team 40-50, description only 20-30; null without keywords

matched_in.description: Best place a keyword matched; null without keywords

source_url.description: API / feed URL the job was read from; on rows without jobs the page we read (null for an invalid input)

fetched_at.description: When the job data was read from the source (ISO 8601, UTC): the nightly index build, or the live read during this run
